name: edinburgh-castle
documented_evidence: HES orientation map names the separate wards and ranges. HES architectural record LB48220 describes the Great Hall as a four-bay rectangular hall with rubble walls, worked stone surrounds, greenish slate roof and crowstepped gables. Named OSM footprint fits control the chapel, gatehouses, barracks and Crown Square ranges.
modeling_qualifications: Mapped Great Hall roof rectangle is approximately26.3×12.7m; no unsupported29m interior dimension is asserted. St Margaret chapel mapped extent is9.8×5.7m. Terrace offsets, secondary roof heights and defensive wall parapet heights are approximate; the perimeter follows the retained production DEM, while Crown Square has an authored common court level. World terrain inspection remains necessary.
attribution: Original procedural metric mesh; no downloaded mesh or photo textures. Map ring evidence: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via Protomaps. Operator texts/images are referenced, not redistributed.
review_status: All3LODs validated and actual-engine capture visually reviewed on frozen app ca938100f84a3acc203e177603e20398a5d4e760e7c7ef4ff915a5de59a0673c. No obvious buried base or source-building interpenetration in reviewed view. Finer architectural dimensions remain estimates where qualified above.
